name: shortboxerr-dev
postCreateCommand: dotnet --info && (sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.nuget /workspaces/shortboxerr 2>/dev/null || true) && if [ -n "${GH_TOKEN}" ]; then echo "${GH_TOKEN}" | gh auth login --with-token; elif [ -n "${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then echo "${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}" | gh auth login --with-token; fi
